packageRules.description: Grouped by the part of the project an update can break, to keep the PR count low while a red check still points at one area. Majors stay in a separate PR per group (separateMajorMinor), so one breaking update cannot hold back the routine ones.
Go modules of the service and of the docs site (Hugo modules); both are verified by the same check gate.
Everything in the workflows (actions, job container image, mise binary for mise-action) only affects CI.
Container images and charts outside CI: the bjw-s common chart, deploy manifests (the e2e Forgejo images join via their own rule below).
The e2e Forgejo images track release lines (LTS, latest), which the compose manager cannot tell apart; the custom managers below handle them.
The e2e Forgejo images (custom manager) belong with the other images.
A new LTS line changes which release the e2e test covers, so it gets its own PR instead of hiding in a group.
packageRules.commitMessageTopic: Forgejo LTS line of the e2e test

packageRules.description: Keeps the LTS service on the current LTS major. Renovate bumps the major itself (custom manager forgejo-lts-line matches this rule's text, so keep its shape).

customManagers.description: mise version installed in CI by mise-action (.forgejo/workflows/*.yaml).
matchStrings: version: (?<currentValue>[0-9.]+) # keep in step with the local mise version

customManagers.description: e2e Forgejo images, one per release line, named by the '# renovate: depName=' comment above each image.
Current Forgejo LTS major in the forgejo-lts rule above. Merging its PR lets the next run move the LTS image onto the new major.

forgejo-lts.description: Forgejo LTS majors whose planned release date has passed, from the schedule Forgejo publishes.
